sn35.113:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Ñātike viharati Giñjakāvasathe || || 2
sn35.113:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā rahogato patisallīṇo imam dhammapariyāyam abhāsi || || 3
sn35.113:1.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇam || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.113:1.10: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 4-7 Sotañca paṭicca || Ghānañca paṭicca ||
sn35.113:1.12: Manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.113:1.19: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 9
sn35.113:2.1: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.113:2.8: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 10-13 Sotañca paticca || || Ghānañca paṭicca || ||
sn35.113:2.10: Manañca paṭicca dhamme ca upajjati manoviññāṇam || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.113:2.15: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || 15
sn35.113:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavato upassuti ṭhito hoti || || 16
sn35.113:3.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā tam bhikkhum upassutiṃ thitaṃ || || 17
